chalisa.do1: I remember Gaṇapati, the son of Girijā, again and again; with joined hands I make my prayer, with Sarasvatī's name for my support.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory to the imperishable Gorakhnāth; show grace, radiant divine Guru. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Victory, victory, victory to Gorakh, virtuous and wise, the yogī who takes any form at will, the giver of boons. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Alakh Nirañjan, the unseen and stainless, is your name; you always do what is for the good of your devotees. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: For whoever sings your name, the sorrows of birth after birth vanish. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: For whoever recites Gorakh's name, no ghost or piśāca comes near. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Knowledge of you is gained through yoga; your form cannot be seen. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: You are formless, abiding in nirvāṇa; the Vedas did not know your glory. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: You are the indweller of every heart; the eighty-four siddhas bow to you. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Ash is on your limbs, and the nāda, the yogī's horn, shines at your neck; matted locks adorn your head most beautifully. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Without you there is no second god; gods and sages worship you. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: You are consciousness and bliss, the benefactor of saints, the bringer of good and the remover of ill. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: You are the complete Brahman, dwelling in every heart; Gorakhnāth illumines all. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Whoever meditates on Gorakh, Gorakh, gains the sight of the form of Brahman. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: You have taken the form of Śiva, and your ḍamaru sounds; beautiful earrings adorn your ears. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Nityānanda is your name; you slay the demons and protect your devotees. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Your form is exceedingly vast; gods, men and sages do not find its end. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Friend of the humble, benefactor of the lowly, take away our sins; O Hara, we are in your refuge. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: You are the light in the discipline of yoga; dwell for ever in the bodies of the saints. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: When your name is taken at dawn, siddhi grows and yoga spreads. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Haṭha, haṭha, haṭha, resolute Gorakṣa: strike, strike, and pin the enemies down. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Come, come, come, fearsome Gorakh; strike the enemy and leave him in ruin. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Victory, victory, victory to the imperishable Gorakh; end your own devotee's round of the eighty-four lakh births. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Unmoving and beyond reach is Gorakh the yogī; grant siddhi, and take away the craving to enjoy pleasures. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Come and cut off the path of Yama; without you, who is my helper? ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Your body is ageless and deathless; Sanaka and the other sages all bear you love. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Your splendour is like that of millions of suns; you are famed as the light of the world. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: The yogīs perceived your māyā, and fixed their meditation on the Supreme Brahman. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Whoever meditates on you gains the eight siddhis and the nine treasures in his own home. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Śiva Gorakh is your name; you have saved the sinful, the wicked and the lowly. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Lord beyond reach, beyond the senses, without fear, stay always with the saints. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Your incarnation is in the form of Śiva; you saved Gopīcand and Bhartṛhari. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Lord, listen to our plea, ocean of mercy, yogī, celibate. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Fulfil your servant's hope; knowing me for your servant, give me knowledge. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Purifier of the fallen, support of the lowly, it is for them that you take incarnation. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Alakh Nirañjan is your name; you spread yoga, the path hard to tread. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Victory, victory, victory to Lord Gorakh; always bring about the welfare of your devotees. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Victory, victory, victory to the imperishable Gorakh; the eighty-four siddhas serve you. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Whoever reads this Gorakh Chālīsā becomes a siddha; the Lord of the world is witness to it. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Let him join his hands and fix his mind in meditation, and make his offering with faith. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever reads it twelve times every day has his heart's desire fulfilled. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: For whoever hears it and recites it, and, moved by love, worships with his own hands, Gorakhnāth fulfils every wish and desire of his heart.
chalisa.do3: Lord beyond reach and beyond the senses, you are an incarnation of the Supreme Brahman; earrings are in your ears, matted locks on your head and boundless sacred ash on your body.
chalisa.do4: Siddha, lord of yogīs, give me your teaching; may I serve you at all times, and greet you with Ādeś, the Nātha salutation, morning and evening.
